supersedes.note: That file parked 266 pks as NEEDS_HUMAN_ambiguous_customer_types and was never touched again. 204/266 were independently resolved and shipped by the 2026-08-22 Florida water-experience pool re-ingestion (#139, FareHarbor price-preview per-item v2 include_breakdown=yes) with no operator key involved -- those 204 need no further action and are not carried forward here. This file re-triages only the 62 pks that are still absent from tours-data.json, against current scope (ALL FLORIDA WATER EXPERIENCES, BOTH COASTS, per #139) rather than the file's original 2026-07-24 heldReason.

method: Read-only GET probe of price-preview/per-item/v2 (include_breakdown=yes) for each pk, 4 dates spanning ~90 days (2026-08-27/09-03/09-26/10-26). No booking-flow POSTs, no repo data touched.

genuinely_blocked.description: In scope, but the current price-preview v2 method cannot recover a real fare: either the customer types are structurally ambiguous (parallel lettered rate codes with no base tier) or the only priced field is a deposit, not the true total. These are the only 2 of the original 266 that still match the deleted file's original premise.

rows.name: Private Half Day (4HR)  Peacock Bass Fishing Charter
rows.reason: the only price-preview fields are per-boat DEPOSIT amounts ($150/$255/$360); the true total fare ($450/$900/$1350) lives only in free-text tier notes, not in any priced field

rows.name: Airboat - Cruise Rates
rows.reason: customer types are 8 parallel lettered rate-code variants (A/B/C/D/F/G/YBR/FTC) of "Adult"/"Child" at different prices ($16-$22) with no unqualified base tier — no way to pick the operative fare without operator rate-plan knowledge
